# Third-party artwork

The included Rider–Waite–Smith card faces are by Pamela Colman Smith, originally published in 1909. They are WebP derivatives of the Wikimedia Commons scans listed individually in `assets/sources.json`, including source URLs, original dimensions, hashes and recorded public-domain status. Those dimensions and hashes describe the original PNG scans, not the WebP derivatives.

The MPL-2.0 software license does not relicense these public-domain card faces. Source PNG scans are not distributed in this package. The custom card back and package software are covered by MPL-2.0.
